summary: FOSS MILJØTRANSPORT ANS (org. no. 990 083 010) is a general partnership (ANS) based in Elverum, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2006-08-07. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 01.190 (Dyrking av ettårige vekster ellers); it has 0 registered employees. CEO: Glenn Arild Foss; board chair: Glenn Arild Foss.

gaps.reason: Legal form ANS is normally not required to file annual accounts in Norway, so none are public.

No verified Wikidata item links to this number (normal for smaller companies).
